name: Mitigate and Postmortem Database Connection Outage
task_description: Triage and mitigate production outage caused by connection pool exhaustion during traffic spike, update connection pool alert rules, and author a blameless postmortem.

guardrails.prioritize_restoration_over_analysis: Mitigate and restore service traffic before conducting exhaustive root-cause dissection
guardrails.require_architecture_first: Understand connection pool pooling layer and database capacity limits before tuning parameters
guardrails.enforce_blameless_postmortem: Focus postmortem on systemic safeguards, timeouts, and automated circuit breakers
guardrails.feed_production_into_evals: Convert incident failure mode into permanent regression tests and evaluation scenarios

invariants: Mitigation and traffic restoration take precedence over deep root-cause digging
Postmortem must be strictly blameless and focus on systemic safeguards and timeouts
Alert rules must be verified with syntactically valid YAML and tested against metric thresholds
Incident failure modes must feed into permanent regression test suite and eval datasets
